Karansul

Biography

Karansul is an Ingos merchant angry that Yam-Akara’s cheap runes undercut his business. Later his private relationship with Geraldine becomes evidence in the murder inquiry: the two provide each other with an alibi and reveal plans to marry. His commercial grudges should not be mistaken for proof of murder. [1, 2]
